headline_seed: Why is China banning drone sales in Beijing?
description_seed: The BBC's Laura Bicker looks into why China has tightened regulations on drones, with authorities citing public safety concerns.

what: Why is China banning drone sales in Beijing?

clean_source_blocks.text: The BBC's Laura Bicker looks into why China has tightened regulations on drones, with authorities citing public safety concerns.
China has gradually tightened regulations on drones in recent years, with authorities citing public safety concerns.
The drone restrictions in Beijing were approved in March. At that time, city authorities said management of drones must be strengthened to respond to "challenges" in low-altitude airspace safety.
China will ban the sale of drones in Beijing and require users to apply for permission for all flights in the capital under strict regulations that enter force on Friday.
